sentences.en: He has no equal in the field of electronics.

sentences.en: Japan is ahead of other advanced countries in electronics.

sentences.en: Among the manufacturers of so-called consumer electronics, there's ruthless, cut-throat competition.
sentences.zh: 在所谓的消费电子产品制造商中，存在着残酷的竞争。
